kata.name: Flyweight weak lens: duplicated instance with equal intrinsic value — the kernel emits no finding; the conventional identity test catches it (null result)
kata.series_verdict: pre-registered: Flyweight has no proven equivalence in ploeh §6; the shared-instance identity claim has no kernel predicate and is expected to emit zero findings, while the conventional identity test catches the fault

expected.detail: the candidate lens is shared-instance identity through client→key→factory and client→flyweight. The fault adds Flyweight row f2 with the same intrinsic value as f1 and routes Client row 1 to f2. The kernel has no object-identity predicate and the fixture carries no equation, so catherine check emits 0 findings. The scripted conventional test compares row identity (factory(key(c)) is flyweight(c)) and catches it. Recorded as a gap and a null result, never a survived claim.

commands: python3 prototype/weak_lens_set_baseline.py --assert  # exit 0: scripted conventional test matches the pre-registered detections
cargo run -q -p catherine-cli -- check fixtures/katas/weak-lens-set/flyweight-fault-duplicate-instance.ct.json --json  # exit 0, 0 findings
cargo test -p catherine-ledger --test weak_lens_set_kata  # frozen evidence test

comparison.conventional_baseline: scripted Flyweight test: for every client, flyweight(client) is the same row as factory(key(client)) — identity, not value equality; covers both client rows

expressibility_gap.invariant: object identity / share count for flyweight instances
expressibility_gap.why: the kernel surface has no identity predicate: two flyweight rows with equal intrinsic values are indistinguishable from one shared row, so the duplicate fixture emits zero findings

discrepancies: ploeh-grounding.md §6 lists these patterns as HYPOTHESIZED candidates, not proven equivalences; this slice records parity or a null result and does not upgrade any of them.
procedure: 1. control first: validate the near-floor control's empty unique set and killed verdict before any positive is read.
2. probe arm: cargo run -q -p catherine-cli -- check <fixture> --json; findings recorded verbatim.
3. baseline arm: python3 prototype/weak_lens_set_baseline.py --assert; detections are the pre-registered element names.
4. unique = probe elements - baseline elements; the element vocabulary is fixed in fixtures/katas/weak-lens-set/README.md.
5. verdict: empty unique with an expressible lens => killed (parity); an unexpressible lens with zero findings => killed with the gap recorded (null result).
